latestVersion.changelog:
Customer Support Command Center 1.0.0 — initial release

- Introduces a full-featured customer support operations system, including ticket triage, response templates, escalation workflows, CSAT tracking, knowledge base management, and churn prevention.
- Details a ticket priority matrix and category tagging system for efficient sorting and routing.
- Provides a structured HEARD response framework and quality checklist to standardize and improve customer communication.
- Supplies an extensive library of customizable response templates for common support scenarios.
- Establishes clear escalation rules and note templates for handling complex or high-impact issues.
- Includes knowledge base content guidelines to help standardize documentation and support resources.
